# ViTacFormer project-page attribution

Source: https://github.com/RoboVerseOrg/ViTacFormerPage/tree/685c8db990e631f2aff539a28315bad79138d06f
Website: https://roboverseorg.github.io/ViTacFormerPage/
Retrieved: 2026-10-19

The source index.html footer states that the website is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Original template credits: SkillBlender, UMI on Legs, RoboPoint, NeRFies, and Scaling Up Distilling Down. The footer specifically requests a link back to https://nerfies.github.io/ when adapting the source. Retain attribution, identify changes, and apply the same license to adapted template material. No claim is made that project media/model/data licenses are the same as the website-template license.

The upstream HTML is archived as .txt so it cannot accidentally run external scripts. The top-level WE-Dream page may adapt its full-height background-video structure; the upstream uses one precomposed desktop MP4 and a separate mobile MP4. No per-tile zoom logic was found in this commit. Its static/js/index.js is empty.
